name: codegraph
description: Local code graph for ZCode as a zero-dependency MCP server: tree-sitter index of 35 languages kept in SQLite under the plugin data folder, exposed through codegraph_status, codegraph_lookup (symbol search, callers, callees, impact, outline) and codegraph_map, so the model reads exact line ranges instead of grepping and reading whole files. The index is built or refreshed silently when a session opens; SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and PostToolUse hooks tell the model when the graph is ready and when to use it. No network, no telemetry.

autoIndex.title: 自动索引
autoIndex.description: 打开后，支持语言的文件数达到 minFiles 的项目在会话打开时后台建索引，并在每次会话开始时检查更新；关闭则只认手动 refresh

minFiles.title: 自动索引的最少文件数
minFiles.description: 支持语言的文件数低于此值不自动建索引，避免在小目录上白跑；写入 CODEGRAPH_MIN_FILES

maxFiles.title: 文件数上限
maxFiles.description: 项目文件总数超过此值不自动建索引；写入 CODEGRAPH_MAX_FILES

exclude.title: 额外排除
exclude.description: 逗号分隔的 glob 或相对路径，追加到内置忽略（node_modules、dist、build 等）之后；留空表示不排除额外内容。写入 CODEGRAPH_EXCLUDE

liftoffOnly.title: 仅用 Liftoff 编译 wasm
liftoffOnly.description: 保险开关：V8 TurboFan 升级让 Node 崩溃时打开，索引会慢约 1.6 倍；写入 CODEGRAPH_LIFTOFF_ONLY
